text: 24. The action of double or multiple pointing may be also reduced declaratory. It is competent to a debtor, who is differed, or threatened with difrdfs, by two or more perform claiming right to the debt, and who therefore bring the feveral claimants into the field, in order to debate and fettle their several preferences, that foe he may pay feeture o him who right shall be found prefie able. This action is daily justified by an erfree, in the cafe of feveral arreffments used in his hands for the fame debt; or by means in the cafe of Several adjuders, all of whom claim right to the fame rents. In thefe competitions, any of the competitors may bring an action of multiple-pointing in name of the tenants, or other debtors, without evercuters, or even though they should claim the proceeds, lose the law has introduced it as the proper remedy for getting both competitions determined. And while the subject in conversely common in realis, any third person who coercive he has a right to it, may, though he should not be cited as a defender, produce his titles, as if he were an original party to the hily, and will be admitted for his interentl in the competition.
